final readonly manifest audit

Evidence boundary

Historical structured evidence from a JSON source. Recorded status values remain source claims; no current Editor, reload, client-tool, or performance acceptance is inferred. The public view preserves bounded technical structure. Arrays show at most 80 entries, object views at most 160 fields, nested detail at most 12 levels, and long strings at most 1200 characters. Credentials, local paths, and embedded media are redacted.
